business_problem: Expedia Group needed to keep travel marketing effective as consumer discovery shifted toward generative AI, while also creating far more content across a massive inventory without overloading marketers or analysts.
solution_summary: Expedia Group is using OpenAI across both marketing operations and traveler discovery. Within the marketing organization, generative AI now augments summarization, trend analysis, descriptive analytics, and content production so leaders can work more directly with live campaign signals instead of waiting on manual analysis. Cross-functional teams pair creatives, ML scientists, developers, and marketers to experiment on focused use cases, using AI to generate text, images, video, and other campaign assets for brand, social, and organic channels. OpenAI tools also moderate output quality so only relevant, high-quality content reaches travelers. At the same time, Expedia is adapting to agentic consumer behavior and exploring how travel search can move from many fragmented queries to a handful of AI-guided interactions, while loyalty programs such as One Key preserve trusted direct relationships through inspiration, planning, and booking. OpenAI APIs further automate the process of identifying and correctly presenting travel imagery on Expedia sites.

solution_components.name: OpenAI APIs
solution_components.role: Power content generation, image presentation, and AI-assisted marketing workflows across Expedia’s brands.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT
solution_components.role: Supports marketers with generative content, analysis, and experimentation across creative and strategic work.

data_flow: Travel-catalog data, campaign inputs, and content assets flow through OpenAI APIs and ChatGPT for analysis, content creation, and moderation. The resulting assets are then deployed across Expedia’s marketing channels and travel-site surfaces, where they support both discovery and booking journeys.
integration_points: Expedia, Hotels.com, and VRBO brand marketing
business_outcome: Expedia increased content velocity across a huge catalog, improved quality control, and positioned its marketing organization to adapt to conversational travel discovery rather than depending only on traditional SEO and channel tactics.
metrics: Hundreds of thousands of properties and vacation rentals in Expedia’s catalog
